instruction: A candid outdoor photograph showing a full-length view of a couple on stone steps. On the left, the man in the white puffer jacket (R2) stands facing right, holding a bouquet of red roses and smiling. On the right, the woman in the pink puffer jacket (R1) stands facing left, embracing him with her arms around his neck and her left heel slightly lifted. They are in a close embrace against a grey stone wall. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural daylight, highlighting the vibrant red of the roses against their neutral-colored clothing.
